services.desc: Start your day on the water, cruising the beautiful South End of LBI! About Enjoy a brunch cruise on our tiki boat! Start the day with a beautiful cruise and start the day on the water! More Info The SBB Tiki Boat is BYO Food and Beverages. Feel free to bring your favorite snacks and libations to enjoy while we captain your excursion. The boat has a restroom and all required U.S. Coast Guard safety equipment, and captains are fully certified and experienced.
